description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the AcknowledgementAggregator class, which manages acknowledgements within a service model, specifically testing various scenarios related to acknowledgement requests and responses.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAggregatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AcknowledgementAggregator, testing its behavior in handling acknowledgements requests and responses, including error conditions and edge cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup before each test, setting up correlation ID and headers.

methods.name: tryToAddNullRequestedAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Tests that adding null acknowledgement request throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: emptyInstanceHasNoMissingAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Verifies that a newly created aggregator has no missing acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: getMissingAcknowledgementLabelsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that missing acknowledgement labels are correctly identified after some acknowledgements are added.

methods.name: tryToAddNullRequestedAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Tests that adding null list of acknowledgement requests throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: emptyInstanceReceivedAllRequestedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Ensures that a new aggregator reports all acknowledgements as received.

methods.name: didNotReceiveAllRequestedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies that the aggregator correctly reports when not all acknowledgements have been received.

methods.name: receivedAllRequestedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies that the aggregator reports all acknowledgements as received after all are added.

methods.name: onlyRegardFirstReceivedAcknowledgementForSameLabel
methods.description: Ensures that for duplicate acknowledgements with the same label, only the first one is considered.

methods.name: tryToAddNullReceivedAcknowledgement
methods.description: Tests that adding a null acknowledgement raises NullPointerException.

methods.name: addFailedReceivedAcknowledgement
methods.description: Tests adding a failed acknowledgement and validates the acknowledgements aggregations.

methods.name: addSuccessfulReceivedAcknowledgement
methods.description: Tests adding a successful acknowledgement and its impact on the aggregator state.

methods.name: unknownReceivedAcknowledgementsAreIgnored
methods.description: Verifies that acknowledgements not matching the expected labels are ignored.

methods.name: successfulAcknowledgementsAreInExpectedOrder
methods.description: Checks that successful acknowledgements are stored and retrieved in order.

methods.name: failedAcknowledgementsAreInExpectedOrder
methods.description: Checks that failed acknowledgements are stored and retrieved in order.

methods.name: successfulAcknowledgementsLeadToHttpStatusCodeOK
methods.description: Validates that when only successful acknowledgements are received, the overall status code is OK.

methods.name: acknowledgementsWithOneFailedLeadToHttpStatusCodeFailedDependency
methods.description: Tests that presence of a failed acknowledgement results in overall status code FAILED_DEPENDENCY.

methods.name: acknowledgementsWithOneTimeoutLeadToHttpStatusCodeFailedDependency
methods.description: Tests that if a timeout acknowledgement is present, overall status is FAILED_DEPENDENCY.

methods.name: tryToGetAggregatedAcknowledgementsForNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks that passing null headers when retrieving acknowledgements throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetAggregatedAcknowledgementsForDittoHeadersWithDifferentCorrelationId
methods.description: Ensures that requesting acknowledgements with mismatched correlation ID throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: createAcknowledgement
methods.description: Helper method creating an acknowledgement with a specified status code.

methods.name: createAcknowledgements
methods.description: Helper method creating a list of acknowledgements with specified count and status.
